name: Discovery
overview: Scripture reveals that discovery is a divine invitation to seek the hidden works and purposes of God, who both conceals and reveals truth according to His glory. The psalmist celebrates the greatness of God's works as those who delight in them diligently seek understanding, while Proverbs contrasts the wise, who search matters out, with fools who lack true understanding. Jeremiah encourages believers to call upon the Lord for revelation of mighty and hidden things, affirming God's gracious intention to guide His people toward a hopeful future. This pursuit of discovery is not rooted in dwelling on the past but in trusting God's unfolding plan and His promise to reveal what is yet unknown.
